reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite providing local computation, formal verification, code repair suggestions, memory retrieval, evidence auditing, and TCM data retrieval through compiled gate tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供数学与逻辑验证、正则检查、代码修复建议、记忆检索、证据审计及中医数据检索工具。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite for symbolic and formal verification, regex checking, code repair suggestions, memory retrieval, evidence auditing, and TCM data lookup.

capabilities: Runs compiled gate binaries through subprocesses
Performs symbolic mathematics, formal logic, regex validation, theorem proving, and state-machine checks
Reads user-provided memory and formula data files
Provides TCM pattern diagnosis and herb-pair retrieval
Audits claims for supporting tool-execution evidence
